rounds.text: Dr Agarwals Eye Hospital Ltd demonstrates exceptional fundamental momentum that significantly outpaces its valuation and market perception [E55]. Over the last five years, compounded profit growth has surged at an extraordinary 120% CAGR [E19, E58], whilst the share price has grown by a more modest 66% over the same timeframe, indicating that fundamentals are running well ahead of price performance [E23, E55]. This top-tier operational execution is backed by elite capital efficiency, highlighted by a 3-year median return on equity of 29% [E28] and an annualized ROE of 25.2% [E13], both comfortably above sector benchmarks [E9]. Furthermore, cash generation is exceptionally robust with cash conversion at 2.07x in March 2026, proving that reported profits are fully and cleanly backed by cash [E34]. A discounted cash flow model establishes an intrinsic value of Rs 5902 per share compared to the current market price of Rs 5000 [E45], leaving a tangible margin of safety [E46] while the reverse DCF implies the market is underestimating achievable earnings growth [E47]. Conceded: the stock trades at a high price-to-book ratio of 6.97x against the backdrop of moderate leverage [E2, E38], and quarterly margins showed a temporary compression [E31].
